name: Reddit, Inc.
moat_justification: Unique two-decade human-conversation corpus and self-moderated community network effects, with emerging ARPU pricing power and licensable AI data value — but distribution is rented from Google search, user switching costs are near zero, the ad business is subscale, and SBC still consumes ~33% of OCF.
fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 9 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
DILUTION: share count growing 52.3%/yr — already deducted via the growth adjustment; check SBC trend
BASIS_BREAK_SUSPECT: a >60% revenue jump/drop in the last 5 yrs — check for divestitures, big M&A, or restatements before trusting any CAGR
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2024 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base
WIDE_SCENARIO_SPREAD: super-bull IV is 4.6x super-bear IV — uncertainty is huge; confidence should not be high
one_liner: Genuinely inflected, high-quality community platform, moat 6/10 — TTM owner's earnings of $3.36/share are real, but at $159.93 (47.5× TTM OE) the weighted IRR is 12.7% (IV@15% $123); it clears the 15% hurdle only below ~$123, and with a margin of safety below ~$100.
moat_for: Unique human-conversation corpus across 100k+ self-moderated communities — AI labs pay to license it
Community network effects with volunteer moderation — expensive to replicate, archive compounds
Emerging pricing power — global ARPU +36% YoY, U.S. +51% (Q2 2026)
Asset-light economics — ~91% gross margin, near-zero capex
International runway — machine translation, intl revenue +84% YoY
moat_against: Distribution rented from Google — logged-out/search traffic at risk from AI Overviews; U.S. logged-in DAUq nearly flat
No user lock-in — multi-homing across TikTok/YouTube/Discord/X, zero switching costs
Ad business subscale vs Meta/Google; intl ARPU $2.26 vs U.S. $11.85 unproven to converge
Data-licensing revenue concentrated in a few AI counterparties, renewals uncertain
SBC load — $338M TTM, ~33% of operating cash flow
Dependence on volunteer moderators — community can revolt (2023 API protests)
